faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does basic security setup take?
delivery.answer: SSL, WAF and backup system installation is typically completed in 3-7 days.

pricing.question: How much does the security service cost?
pricing.answer: We work with a one-time setup fee and monthly monitoring fee. Priced by site size and risk level.

revisions.question: My site has been hacked — can you help?
revisions.answer: Yes. We first clean the site, identify and close the source, then build ongoing security infrastructure.

maintenance.question: How long does a restore from backup take?
maintenance.answer: Depending on site size, we can typically do a full restore within 30-60 minutes.

migration.question: Do you support platforms other than WordPress?
migration.answer: Yes. We support a wide range of technologies including Next.js, Webflow and custom builds.

mobile.question: What does compliance require?
mobile.answer: We assess and implement together: personal data inventory, privacy policy, cookie policy and data security measures.
